hypothesised_causes.title: Prompt List-Order / Low-Index Tag Anchoring in 3B VLM
hypothesised_causes.hypothesis_statement: Candidate rushers are listed in ascending `nflId` order (`R1, R2, R3, R4, R5`) in the prompt. When visual distances in 2D pocket projections are ambiguous, the 3B model may anchor on early candidates (`R1`/`R2`, especially `R2` with the high-contrast cyan ring) rather than later items (`R4`/`R5`).
hypothesised_causes.why_not_directly_proven: Confirming causal attribution to list order vs. ring color requires a controlled permutation ablation (shuffling R-tags and palette colors across identical frames).

hypothesised_causes.title: 2D Interior Pocket Crowding vs. Unobstructed Edge Salience
hypothesised_causes.hypothesis_statement: Interior rushers approaching within 1.3-2.0 yd of the QB frequently overlap with offensive linemen (blue dots), whereas edge/perimeter rushers (`R2` on several plays) have unobstructed colored trails and callout boxes that may appear more visually salient to a general-purpose ViT encoder.
hypothesised_causes.why_not_directly_proven: Attention weights or marker-removal ablations are not observed in standard black-box generation.

hypothesised_causes.title: Instruction/Recency Bias Toward Final Frame Over Early-Snap Proximity
hypothesised_causes.hypothesis_statement: The prompt instructs the model to examine sequential frames 'especially the later frames as rushers converge'. On quick-game plays (e.g., Play 282 where R4 is closest at +0.1s in Frame 1) or plays where a rusher peaks mid-play and rebounds (Play 349), the VLM may overweight the final frame.
hypothesised_causes.why_not_directly_proven: Distinguishing prompt-induced recency bias from multi-image visual token pooling requires prompt and frame-order ablations.

hypothesised_causes.title: Instruction-Tuned Reluctance to Emit Null / Abstention
hypothesised_causes.hypothesis_statement: Even on near-ties (e.g., Play 410 with a 0.45 yd margin) and crowded pockets, the 3B instruction-tuned model always commits to a concrete rusher ID while expressing caveats only in the free-text `uncertainty` field.
hypothesised_causes.why_not_directly_proven: Internal token calibration probabilities were not thresholded separately from greedy decoding.
